name: DLF Ltd
title: DLF Ltd - 532868 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: DLF's FY26 sales of INR 20,143 crore met the ~INR 20,000 crore guidance, but management pushed back on presales growth, prioritising margins and cash, and rental NOI guidance of mid-teens growth is unchanged.

utilisation.quote: continues to operate at industry-leading occupancy of 95%

triggers.label: Dahlias ~INR 135 cr per sale
triggers.quote: Dahlias is now touching about INR 135 crores per sale
triggers.highlight: Dahlias is now touching about INR 135 crores per sale

triggers.label: FY27 sales guidance ~INR 20,000 cr held
triggers.quote: we believe that we will broadly stay on this trajectory of a INR 20,000 crores of sales guidance
triggers.highlight: broadly stay on this trajectory of a INR 20,000 crores of sales guidance

triggers.label: Office vacancy income loss ~3.5%
triggers.quote: the value of income loss because of vacancy is now down to about 3.5% in the overall portfolio
triggers.highlight: down to about 3.5% in the overall portfolio

guidance.quote: we will broadly stay on this trajectory of a INR 20,000 crores of sales guidance
ballpark about INR 9,000-odd crores of new margin creation every year
we will have mid-teens growth in NOI and 20 to 25% growth as a CAGR basis for the next 4 to 5 years
a growth of about 10 to 11% in our income from the existing properties

prior_guidance_check.quote: New sales bookings for the year was in line with our guidance and stood at INR 20,143 crores

prior_guidance_check.metric: Zero gross debt in development business
prior_guidance_check.quote: we achieved zero gross debt position in the development business in the last fiscal

red_flags.label: Presales target not growing; launch pipeline cut from INR 67,000 cr to ~INR 60,000 cr medium-term
red_flags.quote: we will obviously unlock it at the pace at which the market can comfortably absorb

red_flags.label: Large tenants deferring decisions
red_flags.quote: there could be some deferral in their decision-making

evasions.quote: presales is about the wrongest metric that you can use to track us
So again, we do not offer a dividend guidance.
